newsitem.title: USA: Chateau rejects MHC, committed to ROC merger.
newsitem.headline: Chateau rejects MHC, committed to ROC merger.

text.p: Chateau Properties Inc said Wednesday that its board has rejected the revised acquisition offer from Manufactured Home Communities Inc.
"MHC has not offered anything new to Chateau's common shareholders. Chateau is committed to consummating its merger with ROC Communities Inc," company Chief Executive Jeff Kellogg said in a release.
In August Manufactured Home Communities Inc made an unsolicited $26-a-share offer for Chateau, after Chateau had agreed to merge with ROC Communities Inc.
Earlier this month Manufactured Homes revised its proposal, offering Chateau Operating Partnership Unit holders $26 cash or a convertible preferred security.
Chateau shares were trading down 1/4 Wednesday afternoon at 24-3/8. ROC shares were down 1/4 at 24-5/8, and Manufactured Homes closed Tuesday at 19-5/8.
A revised merger pact between Chateau and ROC calls for each Chateau share to represent 1.0316 shares of the combined company.
The original pact was a tax-free stock swap offering one share of the combined company for each Chateau share.
